_doc: Format of an area blueprint (P2-009, tools/bake/areas/blueprints.ts; DELHI_WORLD.md 'OSM is reference, not the final word'). One file per drawn area, named <area id>.json; a file whose name starts with _ is not read. The bake lays the blocks over the repaired footprints: every map footprint under a block, or with its centre inside a clear ring, leaves with a log line (harness/reports/map/areas/parcels.json). Precedence on any square metre: road, landmark zone, blueprint, generator: a block is cut back to the road edge and a block inside a landmark zone is left out. Rings are [lon, lat] lists like areas.geojson. This file is the format only; the area passes (P2-020 to P2-024) write the real ones from the area sheets and photos.
evidence: <the sheet section and photo set the blueprint is drawn from>
clear: optional: rings; map footprints with their centre inside leave (ground the blueprint keeps open)

blocks.id: <letters, digits and _; the parcel is bp/<area>/<id>>
blocks.height_m: <optional: wall height in metres; else the type's floor heights>
blocks.roof: <optional: flat, mumty, setback, crown or gable>
blocks.tint: <optional: a colour word of the area's buildings.colours in palette.json>
blocks.evidence: <the photo or sheet line this block is drawn from>
